name: arca-invoice
description: Issue explicitly approved ARS C professional-services invoices for unidentified consumers under the verified threshold, with durable no-retry issuance, reconciliation and PDF/QR receipts; also provides read-only WSAA/WSFE checks.

PDF_STYLE.prompt: Default PDF style: classic or modern. Invocation args override this preference.

PDF_COPIES.prompt: Default PDF copies: original or all.

ISSUER_IIBB.prompt: Issuer gross-receipts registration or exempt status.

ISSUER_START.prompt: Issuer activity start date for PDF.

COMPLIANCE_REVIEW_DATE.prompt: YYYYMMDD date of reviewed official identification threshold. Must match issue date.

ENVIRONMENT.prompt: homologation or production. Defaults to homologation.
